key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns Policy Mirror Descent for RL with terminal rewards into a trajectory-level objective, eliminating the need to estimate intermediate state values.
engineering_relevance: This makes reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards more practical for LLM training by reducing critic complexity while preserving the same optimal solution as the original PMD objective.
method: Derive a trajectory-level objective from the Bellman equations for autoregressive generation with terminal rewards
Avoid intermediate state-value estimation by using a critic-free formulation
Use a practical loss with a mismatch-correction weight based on a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing that BPO is effective for improving reasoning performance.
watch_item: The practical loss is an approximation, so performance may depend on how well the mismatch-correction weighting is calibrated during training.
